BiblicalUsage: Talmon = "oppressor"; 1) the head of a family of doorkeepers in the temple; some of his descendants returned from exile with Zerubbabel and were employed in their hereditary office in the days of Nehemiah and Ezra; 1a) possibly two other doorkeepers in the time of Nehemiah
